module.name: accounting_imbalances
module.description: Accounting imbalances. Unbalanced entry: sum(debit) != sum(credit) in lines of the same move_id. Unbalanced balance: total sum debit != total sum credit in the period.

rules.rule: Unbalanced entry: group account.move.line by move_id, sum debit and credit per entry. If they differ, it is unbalanced.
Avoid records as dict key: use move_id.id to group.
Sort with operator.itemgetter on list of dicts.

pattern.name: unbalanced_moves
period_balance_check
pattern.description: Check if the period is balanced: sum(debit) = sum(credit)
pattern.code_snippet: # Does the period balance? (start_date, end_date) domain = [ ('move_id.state', '=', 'posted'), ('date', '>=', start_date), ('date', '<=', end_date), ] lines = env['account.move.line'].search(domain) total_debit = sum(l.debit for l in lines) total_credit = sum(l.credit for l in lines) diff = total_debit - total_credit result = { 'total_debe': total_debit, 'total_haber': total_credit, 'diferencia': diff, 'cuadra': abs(diff) < 0.01 } result
